Covered area is about 80 cm², and at 1.5 cm average depth that gives roughly 120 cm³. Allowing for gaps between the beans, I'd estimate about 100 g of food.

Cooked black-eyed peas with tomato sauce run about 1.2 kcal/g, plus some oil. That puts the total at about 130 kcal, so I'll round to 140 kcal for the visible sauce and oil.
